pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pLinks to a nearby Conductor Mast and increases its generation behavior.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Place it on the same level as a mast within the configured search distance.$p2. Right-click to inspect the linked mast.$p3. Wait through the mast’s burst/strike schedule when testing.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pA closer mast can become the chosen link; distance and level are part of discovery, not just visual proximity.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
